'''Blasic Faloun''' is a Captain stationed in the town of [[Almizar]]
== Appearance ==
He has graying hair and is lean faced. He wears a patch over his missing right eye and has a scar from his forehead to his right cheek. He is short.

== Activities ==
A former morat'raken, now he is in charge of the [[Raken]] in Almizar. [[Tylee Khirgan]] and [[Perrin Aybara]], with the letter from [[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath]] come to borrow most of the ''raken'' he has left stationed there.
